CFML Language Reference: Functions

AuthenticatedContext

Returns the name of the security context used by CFAUTHENTICATE (or CFIMPERSONATE) for the current user.

Category

Authentication functions

Syntax

AuthenticatedContext()

Returns

The security context name, or an empty string if nobody is authenticated.

Usage

Useful when a server hosts several security contexts and shared code must know which one is in use. As with AuthenticatedUser, call IsAuthenticated first so that a login remembered in a cookie is picked up. Security contexts are created on the Advanced Security pages of the Administrator.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFIF IsAuthenticated()>
  <CFOUTPUT><P>#AuthenticatedUser()# logged in to the #AuthenticatedContext()# context.</CFOUTPUT>
<CFELSE>
  <CFOUTPUT><P>Not logged in; AuthenticatedContext() returns "#AuthenticatedContext()#".</CFOUTPUT>
</CFIF>

See also

AuthenticatedUser, IsAuthenticated, CFAUTHENTICATE
